title: Notice to Electronic Nicotine Delivery Systems (ENDS) Manufacturers
text:
MISSISSIPPI DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE
Sales and Use Tax Bureau Notice 72-26-06 May 7, 2026
Notice to Electronic Nicotine Delivery Systems (ENDS) Manufacturers
Pursuant to Miss. Code Ann. Section 75-102-2, each manufacturer of an ENDS product that is sold
for retail sale or for sale to a consumer in Mississippi, whether directly or through an importer,
wholesaler, distributor, retailer, or similar intermediary, shall execute a certification form and submit it
to the Department of Revenue with applicable fees and documentation prior to September 1, 2026,
and each year thereafter.
Both initial certifications and annual recertifications will be submitted to the Department of Revenue
through Taxpayer Access Point (TAP). The certification form shall separately list each brand name,
category (example: e-liquid, power unit, device, e-liquid cartridge, e-liquid pod, disposable), product
name, and flavor for each ENDS product that is sold in Mississippi.
Each initial certification and annual recertification must include the following:
1) A copy of the marketing granted order issued by the FDA pursuant to 21 USC Section 387j;
2) A copy of the acceptance letter issued by the FDA pursuant to 21 USC Section 387j for a
timely filed premarket tobacco product application; or
3) A document issued by the FDA or by a court confirming the premarket tobacco product
application has received a denial order that has been and remains stayed by FDA or court
order, rescinded by FDA, or vacated by a court; and
4) Verification that the manufacturer is registered to do business in this state or has a resident
agent for service of process and payment of bond if required; and
5) A payment of Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) for each ENDS product each time a
manufacturer submits a certification for that ENDS product, but not to exceed Fifteen
Thousand Dollars ($15,000.00) annually per manufacturer.
Initial certifications and annual recertifications received by the annual September 1st deadline will be
reviewed and approved products will be placed on the Mississippi ENDS Product Directory on October
1st.
The Mississippi ENDS Directory will be updated monthly.
NO ENDS PRODUCTS may be offered for sale in the State of Mississippi unless the product is listed
on the directory and the product meets all other requirements pursuant to law.
If you have any questions, please contact ENDSDirectory@dor.ms.gov.
P.O. Box 1033 Jackson, Mississippi 39215 Phone: 601-923-7015 FAX: 601-923-7034
